items.evidence: README's play command (--ticks 400 --seed 1 --settings DIR --inputs ...) printed one JSON object with tick, screen, menu_index, language, volume, difficulty, texts, score, best, coins, wave, gate_health, guard_y, quick, heavy, saved, enemies, bolts; --ticks 1 shows screen title.
README's frame command (--ticks 400 --inputs 2:enter,3:shoot --frame frame.png --size 800x480) wrote a PNG that `file` reports as 800 x 480; opened it and saw the play field.

Fresh folder, tick 1: texts [Hold the gate: the long night, Best: 0, Start, Settings, Quit], no Continue. 0:enter -> tick 1 screen play, wave 1, score 0, coins 0, gate_health 10, first walker at x=20.

Settings: right x4 from 8 -> 10 and stays 10; left x12 -> 0 and stays 0. Language right: en->es->fr (stops at fr), left back to en. Difficulty starts normal; right -> hard (stops), left -> normal -> easy (stops).

es and fr runs: title, settings, shop (all price / max / mason-whole variants), play HUD, paused, lost and won texts are all translated (e.g. 'Has ganado', 'Puntos: 1450', 'Intro: título'; 'Vous avez gagné', 'Entrée : titre', 'Vague 2 sur 8'); only the game's name stays English.
Run 1 set volume 3, fr, hard in folder f4; run 2 with the same folder starts with language fr, volume 3, difficulty hard (title in French). A fresh folder starts en / 8 / normal.
Holding up: guard_y 6 -> 6.1 after 1 tick, 7 after 10, reaches 12 and stays at 12; holding down goes 12 -> 6 in 60 ticks and stops at 0.
Shoot held from tick 20: bolts appear at ticks 21, 45, 69, 93 (24 apart); a bolt moves 0.233333 per tick (14/s); bolt at x=19.97 at tick 98 is gone at tick 99.
Seed 1, wave 1: walkers appear at ticks 1, 91, 181, ... (90 ticks apart), 5 in total, lanes 2,4,8,6,6, health 2, moving 0.025 per tick (1.5/s).
Guard at y=2: first bolt hits the y=2 walker at tick 108 (health 2->1, bolt gone); second hit at tick 130 removes it, score 0->10, coins 0->1. Bolts at y=2 pass the y=4 walker (health stays 2).

No input: walker at x=0.025 at tick 800 is gone at tick 801, gate 10->9, score/coins 0. Wave 2 idle: gate reaches 0 and screen is lost with texts [You lost, Score: 0, Best: 0, Enter: title]; also lost with Score: 20 in another run.
Difficulty easy then Start: gate_health 14 ('Gate: 14'); hard then Start: gate_health 7 ('Porte : 7').

Tick 1160 after wave 1's last walker went through: screen shop, texts [Shop, Coins: 0, Next: wave 2 of 8, Quick hands: 5 coins (0/2), Heavy bolts: 12 coins (0/1), Mason: 4 coins (gate 5/10), Next wave]; enemies and bolts empty and guard_y stays 6 with up held for 140 ticks.

start_coins=40: buy Quick hands 40->35 (1/2), again 35->25 (2/2), third Enter leaves 25 and quick 2. With quick 2 held shoot bolts appear at 1205, 1217, 1229 (12 apart); with quick 1 only, at 1173, 1191, 1209 (18 apart).
Heavy bolts 25->13 coins, heavy 1; second Enter leaves 13. In wave 2 a health-2 walker is removed by the first bolt that reaches it (tick 1278->1279, score +10).
Mason at gate 5/10: 13->9 coins, gate 8; again 9->5, gate 10 (not 11); a third time at 10/10 leaves coins 5 and gate 10. With 0 coins at gate 5, Enter on Mason leaves coins 0 and gate 5.

Next wave pressed at 1183: play shows at 1184 'Wave 2 of 8' and the first walker appears at 1244 (60 ticks later); wave 2 spawns at 1244, 1334, ..., 1784 = 7 walkers, none after. Spanish 'Oleada 2 de 8' and French 'Vague 2 sur 8' seen.

Wave 3 (won-run script): walkers at 2284, 2356, ..., 2644 (6) then runners at 2716, 2788, 2860, 2932 (72 ticks = 1.2 s apart); runner health 1, moves 0.05 per tick (3/s); a runner kill gave score 100->115, coins 5->6.

Wave 4: 8 walkers then a brute at tick 3766 with health 6, moving 1/60 per tick. A brute kill gave +40 points and +3 coins (400->440, 7->10). Continued easy save idle in wave 4: gate 6 -> 3 when the brute arrives.

modules/work/waves.json holds per wave interval, walkers, runners and brutes, read by the rules (wave_data). README 'Change a wave' explains it. Not tested by editing, since judges may not change the game.

Scripted sweep run (seed 1, normal, earned coins) played all 8 waves: tick 8909 play score 1250 with one health-2 brute left and gate 8; at 8910 that brute dies (+40) and the screen is won with score 1450 = 1290 + 20*8. Enter -> title with 'Best: 1,450'.

Escape at tick 300 shows paused [Paused, Resume, Title]; enemies and bolts frozen through tick 400; Resume continues from the same positions. But Title from the pause gives screen 'bridge' (texts [name, Best: 0, Title]), a screen not in the brief. It needs a second Enter to reach the title screen.
saved false during wave 1, true at tick 1160 when the shop opens; a later run with the same folder shows [.., Start, Continue, Settings, Quit].

Save left after buying Quick hands (coins 5, quick 1, gate 5, wave 1). Next run: Continue opens shop with 'Coins: 5', 'Quick hands: 10 coins (1/2)', 'gate 5/10', wave 1, score 0. Next wave -> 'Wave 2 of 8', first walker 60 ticks later.

Start with a save: saved true->false, later run has no Continue and kept.save false. Lost and won runs end with saved false. Title from the pause (in wave 2) leaves Continue and kept.save at the last shop's values.

Won run 1450: won screen 'Best: 1,450'; next run's title 'Best: 1,450'. Then a lost run of 20 in the same folder: lost screen 'Score: 20', 'Best: 1,450'; title still 1,450. A fresh folder losing with 20 gets Best: 20 on the lost screen and later titles.
Two identical copies of a kept folder, same seed 7, same script and ticks, --at 100,300,500,700: outputs byte-identical (cmp). Seed 1 vs seed 2 wave 1 lanes: 2,4,8,6,6 vs 4,8,4,2,8.

Play frames at ticks 2800 and 4895: grey gate strip at x=0, blue guard, green walkers, small orange runners, big red brutes and white bolts each at 40 px per unit from the state's x and y. HUD shows Score, Coins, Wave N of 8 and Gate.
Frames: French title with Continuer outlined (menu_index 1), Spanish settings with 'Idioma: Español' outlined, French shop with 'Maçon : 4 pièces (porte 1/10)' outlined.
assets/strings/en.json, es.json, fr.json (one table per language); UI files use @keys and the rules use message keys; README 'Add a language' explains copying en.json.
README has How to play, kept data (--settings FOLDER/settings.json with volume, language, difficulty, kept.best, kept.save) and the play and frame commands, which both ran as written.

defects: Escape in the shop (and on title, won and lost) opens the pause instead of doing nothing, as the README admits; the brief says Escape does nothing in the shop.
Title from the pause leads to an extra 'bridge' screen (reported screen value 'bridge', not in the brief's list) that needs another Enter.
The settings screen is drawn over the title, and the game's name shows partly hidden behind the settings panel.
The first walker of a wave does not move on the tick it appears (x stays 20 for its first tick), so it trails its own 1.5 s spacing by one tick of walking (2.225 vs 2.25 units).
